notes.title: Fresh Tracks, Explosive Arena Mode & Tuning Upgrade!
notes.content:
Hey, Racers!

The latest EXOcars update just dropped, and it’s bringing insane battles, epic new tracks, and even better car customization!

[h2]🌍 New Tracks in the Aerodrome Biome[/h2]
Race across two brand-new tracks in a massive Aerodrome—speed down old runways, weave between abandoned planes, and tear through endless desert landscapes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957029/11ed70b50912becca64d9c86757ca9388662dd1b.png[/img]

[h2]🔥 New Game Mode: Arena[/h2]
Get ready for total chaos! Smash, ram, and blast your opponents, hit insane jumps, and watch the battlefield explode in Arena Mode. Only the toughest will survive!

[h2]🚗 Tuning System Upgrade[/h2]
Fine-tune your ride like never before! Customize your car’s performance and handling to stay ahead of the competition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957029/7eb1ec46b5311025272da834adf1ddf7191bc72b.png[/img]

We’ve also made tons of fixes and improvements to keep your races smooth and intense.

[i]Buckle up and hit the track—this update is a game-changer! 🏎️💥[/i]

#EXOcars #ArenaMode #NewUpdate #VRRacing

notes.title: Winter's Workshop: Part 2. New AI Enemies & Frosty Challenges!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, VR Racers![/b]

Winter's Workshop: Part 2 is live!

The second festive update for EXOcars brings even more variety to the game!

[b]🎄Holiday Multiplayer Event[/b]
Battle it out on a snowy arena and hit as many opponents as you can using snowballs! This limited-time mode is a must-try!

[b]🚗 New AI Opponents[/b]
You asked, and we delivered! Single-player now lets you race against AI opponents in addition to the ghost cars of real players. Customize their difficulty and race parameters to create your perfect racing experience.

[b]🔧 Fixes and Improvements[/b]
Based on your feedback, we’ve addressed multiple bugs to make EXOcars even smoother and more enjoyable for everyone:
- Fixed a bug that caused player recordings to break;
- Addressed a rare issue where race results were visually incorrect, syncing animations with actual finish times;
- Adjusted controller offset for Steam users;
- Inactive controllers now disable instead of drifting forward;
- Fixed several multiplayer bugs to ensure a smoother experience.


[b]Need to feel some holiday spirit? [url=https://discord.gg/arBpFthE3b]Join us on the track![/url][/b] 🏎️✨

notes.title: Winter update for EXOcars brings custom tuning and festive racing!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello VR Racers![/b][/h3]

🎉 [b]Winter's Workshop: Part I is live![/b] 🎉

This is a major winter update with exciting features you’ve asked for - and we’ve added them!

Let’s take a look at what’s included:

🚗 Car Tuning:
You can now adjust parameters like engine power, surface grip, gearbox type, and more.
These settings directly impact how your car drives and feels in races.

For example:
More engine power = faster acceleration.
Stronger brakes = later braking before turns.
The gearbox type can help with quick acceleration or higher top speed for straights.
Improvements can be purchased with in-game currency!

🌲 Training Arena:
A track where players can practice controls and get comfortable before jumping into races.
You can also test different car setups here!

❄️ Winter Event (Singleplayer):
In this limited-time mode, players race to find gift boxes as quickly as possible on a festive winter track!

We hope you enjoy this update and can’t wait to hear your feedback! We’re also hard at work on the next part of the EXOcars Winter Event, which will include even more features based on your requests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957029/1a4fa43cabed1e407e43a5b5622b37f041da8b63.png[/img]

See you on the track! 🚗✨

[b]More details in our Discord server:[/b] https://discord.gg/fdxBJ9KWne

notes.title: Improved Steering Wheel Support and Force Feedback
notes.content:
Hello, racers!

We’ve carefully reviewed player feedback and suggestions.

[h2]The first EXOcars update is now live![/h2] 🚗💨

[b]We’ve made a number of improvements and changes to enhance your experience:[/b]

[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Launch Details, Game Modes and Roadmap
notes.content:
VR Racers!

We're super excited to watch you jump into an EXO car and hit the track today.
Important information in this post will help you get a smooth first experience with the game.

[h2]1. Game Modes Explained[/h2]

EXOcars features multiple game modes to suit different racing fans and keep it fresh.

[h3]Career (aka Asynchronous Multiplayer)[/h3]
In this mode, you race against not some AI opponents, but 'ghosts' of real players who have already completed the track. Opponents are matched to your skill level, ensuring you get a fair and fun challenge.

You will race through 9 different biomes to unlock all tracks, earn rewards, and climb the leaderboards.
The core value is in replayability: this mode lets you progress organically, honing your skills against increasingly challenging opponents every time you replay a track — without the need to be online every day.

And for obvious reasons, car collisions are disabled in this game mode.

[h3]Real-time Multiplayer Racing[/h3]
Play with up to 3 friends or random players. Car collisions can be set ON or OFF in the lobby settings.

[h3]Real-time Multiplayer Combat[/h3]
It's a 4-player fun alternative mode! While racing, players can pick up weapons from boxes along the track, each providing a unique power-up.

Attack the opponent overtaking you with a homing missile or a volley of rockets! Slow down your rivals and speed yourself up! Defend against players behind you using mines and a shield!

In this mode, players can have all the fun they want, pushing opponents off the track and battling their way to victory! But stay alert—your rivals won’t go easy on you!

[h3]Tournament Mode[/h3]
Limited-time events with real prizes and an entry fee in in-game currency earned in other game modes. The first big tournament is scheduled for November 28, so stay tuned and follow XOCUS on socials or Discord for more details.

[h2]2. Content Roadmap[/h2]
To prove that we are serious about the future of the game, please take a look at the content roadmap attached. And see you in the game! 🏁

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957029/33fb38a5df85d87591e41a33c3e25f200181a0b2.jpg[/img]

More information about wheel support can be found in this thread! https://steamcommunity.com/app/2898310/discussions/0/6400272499512211839/


🎮 For more info, news, and discussions, check out the [b]EXOcars Discord server[/b] and join our awesome VR racing community! https://discord.com/invite/cdvdsAcyNm

notes.title: Be Part of the EXOcars VR Racing Playtest
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey VR racers![/b][/h1]

[b]We’re excited to announce a playtest for EXOcars, the VR racing game from XOCUS! [/b]

[u][b]The test will run from October 4-6[/b][/u], and we’re inviting all Quest and Steam VR players to join in! 
Your feedback is crucial as we near the finish line.

[b]Register here:[/b] https://joyway.games/exocars_playtest

And here’s the second piece of good news! 
After releasing the EXOcars trailer, the most common question we got was about steering wheel and pedal support. We’re happy to confirm that EXOcars will support wheels and pedals for PS VR2 and PC VR at launch!
While the game is fun with standard controllers, using a steering wheel and pedals adds realism and immersion. Wheels provide precise control, while pedals improve acceleration and braking.
The XOCUS team is hard at work to ensure a thrilling racing experience!
The EXOcars release date will be announced soon, so stay tuned! Join our Discord server to make sure you don’t miss it! https://discord.gg/fdxBJ9KWne  

[b]See you on the track![/b]

P.S. Which steering wheel and pedals do you use? We're curious to know which setups are most popular among our players.
